title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the kth largest element in the array (the kth largest in sorted order, not the kth distinct element).
hints: Maintain a min-heap of size k containing the k largest elements seen so far.
If a new element is larger than the heap's smallest, replace it.
The heap's top after processing all elements is the kth largest.
